verdict.rationale: Postmark documents open tracking per server and per email, link (click) tracking, a Message opens API, and a Message tracking API to search and retrieve message details. Together these cover tracking and querying what happened to a given email, with activity retained for 45 days by default and up to 365 days. Missing for 10: an explicit per-message event timeline/history endpoint described beyond headline titles, a documented per-message click query API (clicks only appear in aggregate stats), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track opens and clicks and query a per-message event history via the API to answer 'what happened to this email?'

citations.quote: Tracking opens per Server \- Tracking opens per email \- Message opens API
Message tracking]: Search and retrieve message details
Stats API]: Get delivery, open, and click statistics
Customizable data retention up to 365 days (45-day default)
